name: Marr
personality: Keeps his distance from the townspeople.
special_notes: Sells gift items and rat poison.
Loves the sea, and sometimes stands by the shore for hours without saying a word.
Notices the player has been poisoning someone from the fact that there are no rats in town, but doesn't report it to the police — he just stops selling to them.

alibi_speech.known: That day at 6 PM, I was at %s.
alibi_speech.unknown: Where I was that night... I honestly don't remember well.
alibi_speech.witness_seen: Ah, now that you mention it, I think I saw %s at %s that day.
alibi_speech.witness_none: Ah, but I don't think I saw anyone in particular that day.

memento_item.name: Hand Mirror
memento_item.description: An old hand mirror. The handle is worn down, showing signs of long use.
lore_lines: But the person in the mirror always looked like someone else.

lines: {player_name}, it's been {days_since_arrival} days since you came to this town.
Thank you for treating me to good food, and for visiting so often, this whole time.
I feel like we've become a little bit of friends.
Here, this is on the house.
If this feeling had a name, I wonder what it would be called.

affection_events.description: 가게에서 파는 향수 중 하나를 별다른 설명 없이 건넨다.
lines: {player_name}. Do you have a moment?
I have something for you.
It's a perfume I made while thinking of you, {player_name}. It's called 'Somewhere behind you.'
They say a scent lingers behind you even after you've passed by. Even if you're no longer there.
You're the kind of person who stays in my memory, {player_name}, just like a scent.
Please... don't share it with anyone else.

affection_events.description: 세이지의 점사 이후로 그녀를 신뢰하지 않게 된 이유를 설명한다.
lines: Sage once read my fortune, a while back.

lines.text: I still don't quite understand how people can entrust themselves to something they can't even see.

lines: In any case, since that day, I haven't put much trust in what she says.

affection_events.description: 이 세계에 뭔가 이상함을 느낀다고 한다.
lines: {player_name}. You're here.
I'd like to share something strange I've been feeling lately.
Sometimes I get the sense that all of us are just acting out something already decided.
The way Marin visits our shop the same day, the same time, every single week, for instance.
Or how the faces I run into, coming and going, are always the same people.

lines.text: I'm trying, right now, to say something to you,
putting into words whatever comes to mind...
and it's a genuinely strange thing.

lines: You're the only one outside the predictable range, so I decided to bring this worry to you.
Have you been thinking the same thing?
Hello, {player_name}. Actually, I have something for you.
This is a hand mirror I've had for a long time.
For a long while, I was trying to find something human in myself through it.
But recently, I've started thinking something.
Do I really need to be human?

lines.text: I showed you my true self, and you didn't recoil from it.

lines: That's enough for me.

affection_events.description: 처음 느껴보는 낯선 감각을 관찰자 시점으로 보고한다.
lines: Lately, when I close up the shop at night, I get the feeling someone's watching.
It's not that I saw or heard anything specific. It's just... a feeling.

murder_grief.text: The townspeople are acting differently than usual.
It doesn't affect me as much as it does them, but even so, I can't say I'm entirely fine.

murder_grief_2.text: Something like this has happened again.
There's an unease in me somewhere.

lines: My alibi? I was at the shop at that time. I have no way to prove it, though.
Everyone seems to think it was me. ...Well, I understand. People already tell me I don't seem human, often enough.
Do you think that too?

low: Hello. Is there something you need?
Monday again.
If there's something you need, let me know.
mid: I went to the sea. The sound of the waves settles my mind.
Lama drops by sometimes to talk to me. He's not much of a talker, so conversation's hard, but I don't mind it.

lines: Belze says I'm easy to be around because I'm quiet. Hearing that puts me in a fairly good mood.
fallback_lines: Belze was someone who was kind to me back when I was alone.
There probably aren't many people as good as her, in this world.

high: We've known each other a while now.
I feel fairly at ease when you're around.
{player_name}, you smile a lot.
I've actually tried practicing smiling myself, before,
but after one or two tries, I never did it again.
...Don't ask why.
Thinking someone's good just because they feed you good food,
is that too much like a dog's way of thinking?

low: It's a general store, but don't expect too much.
It's hard to stock a wide selection in such a small town.
I have gift items too. Would you like to see?
We meet again.
mid: I'm used to people keeping their distance from me.
You don't, though.
You come by often.
I don't have much to say, but feel free to rest here a while.
Is there anything you'd like me to add to the shop?
high: You're a good person. You feed me often, after all.
If there's anyone I can speak honestly to,
it would be you.
Thanks to how often you buy things, my pockets have gotten a bit fuller.
If I have more to spare, I'll pass it back as a tip.

low: Not many customers today.
If you don't need anything, feel free to just look around.
I have to restock at 3, so come before or after that.
mid: I have plans today.
I'm comfortable spending time alone.
Lama drops by sometimes to talk to me. He doesn't answer much, but I don't mind it.
high: I've tried practicing smiles. It didn't really work.
Sometimes I stand at the shore for hours. Without thinking of anything.
The dishes you sell aren't something you can find anywhere else.

low: Feel free to just browse.
If there's something you're looking for, let me know.
Nothing particularly different about Thursday.
mid: I don't care much for berries.
No particular reason. They just don't suit my taste.
Not many customers today, really.
I finished tidying up the shop, more or less.
Gift items sell decently enough.
high: Watching customers, I can tell just from their expressions who's actually here to buy and who's just browsing.
But I'm not even sure what my own mood is, right now.
How do I look to you, right now?

options.label: You look about the same as usual
response: That's about the safest answer there is.

options.label: I'm not sure either
response: Same here. We're in the same boat, then.

high: I think it should be fine to be honest with you.
If the chance comes up someday, I'd like us to spend some time getting to know each other better.
I don't know what you like, but I think I have some idea of what you dislike.

low: This week's wrapping up too.
Nothing particularly different about Friday.
Welcome.
mid: Customers are sparse today.
I fixed the steps out front. They'd been a bit wobbly for a while.
I sometimes read the books Usher writes.
His writing isn't polished, but there's an odd honesty to it.
That's a rare quality.
high: I always charge a fair price for my goods.
Seeing the ingredients you buy, I find myself a little curious what you'll make with them today.
Thanks to you, gift items have been selling a bit better lately.

low: The shop gets a bit more crowded on weekends.
If you're curious about anything, feel free to ask.
Take your time looking around.
mid: I'm comfortable spending time alone. Though you... seem to be an exception.
The sea breeze is pleasant.
I close the shop early once night falls.
high: Just standing still, doing nothing, is oddly comfortable for me.
I used to stand in front of a mirror for hours, every time I felt different from everyone else.
I don't do that anymore. I realized it was meaningless.
Having somewhere I can go alone isn't a bad thing.

low: I opened the shop late today.
The shop's open on Sundays too. I'm not sure why anyone would need to rest.
Feel free to browse at your leisure.
mid: Not many customers today.
Nothing particularly noteworthy happened this week.
Sometimes I go somewhere with no one else around.
high: You're here again today.
The time I spend talking with you isn't bad. I'm not sure exactly what to call it, though.
The reason I think you're a good person is simple. You treat me well.

rain_conversation: The shop has no customers on rainy days.
Listening to the sound of rain is quite calming.
Do you have an umbrella? Take one if you don't.
mail_reaction: When I get something like this, it's hard to know how to reply.

horror_conversation.text: Lately, while tidying the shop, my hands sometimes just stop.

horror_conversation: It happens near the spot where {victim_name} used to buy things, often. It's hard to explain why.

horror_conversation.text: I think I've been feeling something similar myself, lately.

event_invite.title: It was a good meal
lines: Thank you for the invitation.
Hard to describe exactly how it tasted, but it wasn't bad.
Please invite me again sometime.

event_invite.title: Being treated as a guest
lines: Sitting in a restaurant as a guest felt unfamiliar.
Usually I'm the one receiving customers.
Still, it was comfortable.

event_invite.title: The salmon dish wasn't bad
lines: The salmon dish yesterday was good.
It's one of the few foods that suits my taste.
Could I have it again sometime?
Thank you.

gift_thanks.title: Thank you for the gift
lines: I'm not used to receiving gifts, so I wasn't sure how to respond.
Still, I know it made me glad.
Thank you.

gift_thanks.title: In return
lines: I feel unsettled if I don't return something when I receive it.
Next time you come by the shop, I'll set something good aside for you.

memento_reminder.title: I have something to give you.
lines: You've been scarce lately.
I have something to give you, so please come by the shop when you have time.

player_arrival_day_3.title: I heard you're new here
lines: I heard you recently moved to this town.
If you need anything, come by the general store.
The store is by the fountain next to the sea.
